correctness.rationale: For n≥7 and m≥2, replacing each original independence-complex vertex by m mutually exclusive clones is exactly Ind(C_n[K_m]). The mapping-cone splitting for each clone attaches a cone over the link through the original vertex cone, hence nullhomotopically, yielding K^[m] ≃ K ∨ ⋁_{∅≠S∈K}(m−1)^|S| Σ^|S| lk_K(S). For an independent cycle set S, links join path independence complexes from cyclic gaps g_i; only gaps 0 or 2 mod3 contribute spheres. Let t count 2-mod3 gaps, h=(n+t)/3; every surviving suspended sphere has dimension h−1. Cyclic gap count n/s binom(s,t)binom(h−1,s−1) and binomial summation produce n/t binom(h−1,t−1)(m−1)^t m^(h−t), with extra n=3h term 3(m^h−1); original cycle homotopy gives base. Full independent mod2 face/boundary checks reproduced cases (7,2),(8,2),(7,3), including mixed-dimensional ranks, but the mapping-cone proof is what establishes integral homotopy/no torsion for all n,m.
